shortDescription: Stacked z-levels (sky/surface/basement) as ONE BIG MAP with live see-below. Pass 40 (built green): bulk-haul heavy-stack fallback; cross-level RMB null-coalesce; equal storage-priority never crosses; vanilla haulability parity (chunks need Orders->Haul); multi-hop chain hauling (nearest accepting level); and idle-pawn FETCH is now far-destination aware so a pawn goes to another level to start a multi-hop haul.
body:
# As above, So below

## Pitch
Real, robust z-levels capped at three per column: sky above, surface, basement below. Priorities: (1) visual clarity from the sky with a live surface view; (2) performance; (3) **full vanilla parity — the column is ONE BIG MAP**.

## TESTING RULE (USER DIRECTIVE 2026-07-25)
**NEVER launch tests with the user's full modlist (isolated=false).** ALWAYS isolated=true with a minimal companionMods set (Dubwise.DubsBadHygiene for DBH, Krkr.rule56 for CAI, Mehni.PickUpAndHaul for bulk-haul) + build a fresh column via the dev action "As above\\AB: ensure sky + basement". NOTE: the auto-PIN of that palette entry can log "Could not find node from path ... Removing." at startup (pin loads before debug actions register) - run it manually from the debug menu. Non-isolated only if the user explicitly asks.

## Locked decisions
- Standalone C# + Harmony. Soft compat via detection/reflection. ABGuard kill switches, fail open + in-game Message. Vanilla sentence case, ASCII only.
- Cap 3 levels. Cross-gap GAMEPLAY only sky<->surface; basement routing-only. Below view PLUMB.
- Selection survives column view switches AND pawn level-changes. All levels real maps; viewing swaps Find.CurrentMap.
- **See-below = RENDER overlay + per-interaction input hooks, NOT a general see-through.**
- **Designators OUT OF SCOPE (pass 33).**
- Logistics doctrine: every ferry MONOTONE. Storage=vanilla+capacity clamp + delivered-level retention (pass 34).
- **WORK doctrine (pass 36): the column is ONE BIG MAP for work priority.**
- **HAULING / STORAGE-PRIORITY doctrine (pass 37, REFINED p40):** ONE BIG MAP for storage priority, but a cross-level storage move fires ONLY when the destination tier STRICTLY beats the best storage the item can reach on its OWN level. Equal (or lower) never crosses. Allow Tool Haul Urgently (ignorePins) still crosses. Monotone.
- **HAULABILITY PARITY doctrine (p40):** cross-level auto-haul mirrors vanilla. A NON-alwaysHaulable thing (stone/slag chunk) is only auto-hauled when DESIGNATED (Orders -> Haul) or already in storage; corpses are alwaysHaulable and unaffected. Enforced in `TargetLevelFor` AND `CrossLevelHaulChain.CanStartFor`.
- **MULTI-HOP HAULING doctrine (p40, "stop at first level that accepts it"):** a stack whose only accepting storage is 2+ levels away is carried gap-by-gap and stored at the NEAREST (fewest hops) accepting level. Greedy per-landing store-or-hop; drop (self-heal) on a dead end. Origin never accepts it, so no bounce-back. Push side = `CrossLevelHaulChain` from a pawn on the item's level; PULL side = the idle FETCH giver, now far-destination aware (p40 FIX 6) so an idle pawn on another level goes to the item's level to START the push chain.
- **COMBAT:** projectiles spawn on the TARGET map. VISUALS (p38): real 1:1 projectile. FoW (p39): optional CAI 5000.
- **Soft-compat HARD RULE (p35):** foreign types never in a SIGNATURE/field. CAI reflection-only.
- **RE-ENTRANCY HARD RULE (p40):** re-entering a patched vanilla method, a foreign prefix may skip the original and leave nulls; coalesce at the boundary.

# PASS 40 — HAUL/MENU FIX WAVE (BUILT GREEN 0/0, in-game verify ongoing)
- **FIX 1** bulk-haul heavy-stack fallback + no walk-the-queue.
- **FIX 2** cross-level RMB red error (Melee Animation postfix NRE) - coalesce re-entrant result/context.
- **FIX 3** equal-tier storage never crosses (`TargetLevelFor` discards non-`beatsLocal` unless ignorePins).
- **FIX 4** vanilla haulability parity - non-alwaysHaulable things need Orders->Haul designation or in-storage; enforced in TargetLevelFor + CrossLevelHaulChain. (VERIFY: user reported undesignated chunks still hauling - suspect in-STORAGE chunks being tier-upgraded, or PUAH's own opportunistic haul; loose+undesignated is gated on every path. Needs clarify loose vs stockpiled.)
- **FIX 5** MULTI-HOP cross-level hauling (`CrossLevelHaulChain` + `AB_HaulChainAcrossLevels` on the existing driver) - carries a stack to the nearest accepting level; fixes "pawns do not haul across 2 levels".
- **FIX 6** (this pass) FETCH is far-destination aware: `WorkGiver_ABFetchFromOtherLevels` now also checks `CrossLevelHaulChain.TryStartFarHaul` for off-level items, so an idle pawn on level A goes to level B to start a 2+ gap haul (user report: "pawns on the ground floor will not go downstairs to haul something to the second floor... unaware of the basement levels items"). Removed the `VirtualScanActive` guard from `CanStartFor` (TryStartFarHaul does NO virtual swaps, safe to evaluate inside the fetch scan). ROOT CAUSE of the report: push givers scan pawn.Map only; idle work-migration virtual scans SKIP our cross-level givers (VirtualScanActive) so they never saw cross-level haul work on another level; fetch was adjacent + TargetLevelFor-only (no multi-hop). FIX 6 closes the pull side; a full per-level "haulable index" framework was considered and deemed unnecessary for this.

# PASS 39 — OPTIONAL CAI 5000 (Krkr.rule56) (phases 1-3 built green, pending verify)
# 38 COMBAT VISUALS · 37 STORAGE-PRIORITY HAUL · 36 ONE-BIG-MAP WORK (VERIFIED) · 36b AIM POSE (VERIFIED) · 36c MODDED TURRET · 35 DBH/GRAVSHIP/DELETE/LEVELGEN · 34 · 33 SEE-BELOW INPUT (VERIFIED)

## Modern Dev Tools integration — SHIPPED About/known-issues.json (inert without MDT).

## REMOVED FEATURES
SKYLIGHTS (r7). MOUNTAIN RIVERS + WATERFALLS (r12). Stairwell heat exchange. CROSS-LEVEL TRACERS (p38). Equal-tier lateral cross-level storage moves (p40). Auto-haul of UNDESIGNATED loose chunks (p40).

## VERIFIED (USER)
RMB cross-level · basement · mech charge · bill supply + mech RMB · p33 see-below input · p36 work priority · p36b aim pose.

## Compat
DBH/VEF/Rimefeller/VCHE · Biomes! Caverns · Alpha Biomes · BM+MO · Odyssey+VLE · Misc. Robots/++ · **Pick Up And Haul / Hauler's Dream (bulk cross-level; heavy-stack fallback p40; far chain single-item)** · Allow Tool · Ancient urban ruins · CE (p38) · Achtung!/Reverse/Giddy-up/Vehicle Framework/Windows/Declutter/Animal Tab/Colonist Bar KF · Trader Airships, Hospitality · BAM · PO/Dubs Analyzer/TPT · WVC Work Modes · Stratum · Sand & Snow Coverage · Modern Dev Tools · Perspective: Ores · CAI 5000 / Krkr.rule56 (p39) · Melee Animation / Float Sub-Menus (p40 coalesce) · turrets: any Building_Turret w/ projectile verb (p36c) · INCOMPAT: MultiFloors, Z-Levels Beta, Strata · UNSUPPORTED: RimThreaded, non-projectile/CE-verb turrets across levels.

## STANDING TEST QUEUE (run ISOLATED + dev-built column)
**PASS 40 (TOP):**
- FIX 6 (pull side): idle pawn on the GROUND, designated chunks on the BASEMENT, chunk stockpile on the SKY (surface bare). The ground pawn must go DOWN to the basement and carry a chunk up to the sky. Also basement pawn present -> push chain still works.
- FIX 5 (multi-hop push): designated basement chunks + sky-only stockpile -> carried basement->surface->sky; add a surface stockpile -> stop at surface.
- FIX 4 (haulability): undesignated LOOSE chunks left alone; designating -> hauled. (Clarify the "undesignated still hauling" report: loose or in a stockpile?)
- FIX 3 (equal priority) · FIX 1 (Mehni.PickUpAndHaul no loop) · FIX 2 (co.uk.epicguru.meleeanimation no red RMB error).
**PASS 39 CAI 5000** (Krkr.rule56). 38 · 37 · 36c · 35 queues.

## DEV DIAGNOSTIC SUITE
AB: ensure sky+basement · basement/light/RMB/below-view diagnostics · cross-gap combat / auto-engage / targeting-hub self-tests · CAI fog self-test (p39).

## Status
2026-07-26 (pass 40, BUILT GREEN 0/0, verifying in-game): SIX haul/menu fixes. Latest: (5) multi-hop push chain (nearest accepting level) and (6) idle FETCH made far-destination aware so a pawn crosses to another level to START a multi-hop haul (fixes "won't go downstairs to haul to the second floor"). No new framework needed - the pull side just needed multi-hop awareness. Open: user report that undesignated chunks still haul - loose+undesignated is gated on every initial path, so suspect in-storage tier-upgrade or PUAH; awaiting clarify. Testing ISOLATED + dev column; PUAH + Melee companions.
